title: FestivalIndex
description: Schema for the repo-root index.json, a generated summary of every festival.json in the repo. Meant for multi-festival selection UIs: enough header info to list/sort/filter festivals plus cheap aggregate counts, without loading every full festival.json. This file is generated by scripts/generate-index.py — do not hand-edit it.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this index schema (not of any individual festival). Bump when the shape of an entry changes.

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the generation run that produced this file.

festivals.description: One entry per festival.json found in the repo, sorted by earliest festivalDays entry (soonest first), then by name.

id.description: The festival.json's own globally unique id, e.g. 'summer-breeze-2026'.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the source festival.json, e.g. 'summer-breeze/2026/festival.json'.

version.description: The source festival.json's own 'version' field, so consumers can detect the source data changed independently of this index.

festivalDays.description: Full copy of the festival's ISO festivalDays, in order. First/last entries give the date range; the full list lets a consumer avoid re-deriving day-by-day scheduling info just to show 'runs Mon-Fri'.

isMultiStage.description: True if the source data has more than one stage (stages.length > 1).

translationLangs.description: BCP 47 language tags with a translations[] entry in the source data, e.g. ['de']. Empty array if none.

counts.description: Cheap aggregate counts, so a picker can show e.g. '135 artists' without loading the full festival.json.

links.description: Total links[] entries, global and per-artist combined.

globalLinks.description: Subset of links[] with no artistId (shown on the Home screen).

topGenres.description: Up to 10 most common artist genre tags, mapping genre name to number of artists with that genre. Ordered by count descending, then genre name ascending. Empty object if the festival has no artists with genres.
